paras: Monopeltis zambezensis is a species of amphisbaenian in the family Amphisbaenidae. The species is indigenous to southern Africa.
M. zambezensis is found in Zambia, Zimbabwe, and presumably western Mozambique.
The preferred natural habitat of M. zambezensis is red soil in Mopane woodlands.
M. zambezensis is very small and slender for its genus. Adults usually have a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of only 15–20 cm (5.9–7.9 in). The maximum recorded SVL is 23.5 cm (9.3 in).
The mode of reproduction of M. zambezensis is unknown.
